title: Changes to Cloudflare Workers are not producing Event Subscription events
summary: The issue has been identified and a fix is being implemented.

timeline.body: Changes to Cloudflare Workers are temporarily not producing Event Subscription events. We have intentionally disabled this feature due to an on-going issue. We are actively working to restore it, but this, regrettably, may take a while. Changes to Workers themselves are working normally. Already deployed Workers are entirely unaffected.
timeline.label: investigating

timeline.body: The issue has been identified and a fix is being implemented.
timeline.label: identified
